Satyadeep questioned avoiding JVs for India expansion. Naren: consolidate existing JVs; leverage home market franchise and value chain control strength.
Amit (Goldman Sachs) pressed circumspect capacity expansion with strong FCF. Naren: Iron ore and coal costs rising; downstream priority outweighs upstream.
Pinakin (HSBC): Will Netherlands stay EBITDA positive post-coke closure? Naren: Historically always positive except BF relining years; margins compress but stay viable.
